memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: Every new freelancer is onboarded with this checklist: check the company number in the KBO/BCE public search; collect proof of affiliation with a social insurance fund; for foreign freelancers collect a Limosa L1 receipt and an A1 certificate; and obtain a signed contract without fixed working hours.

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Proposal for the onboarding checklist for every new freelancer:

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: 1. check the company number in the KBO/BCE public search

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: 2. collect proof of affiliation with a social insurance fund

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: 3. for foreign freelancers: Limosa L1 receipt and A1 certificate

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: 4. signed contract without fixed working hours

quote.text: Approved — this is our checklist from now on.
